mission.outcome: Operator can claim a curve the detector missed by drag-box on the raw-log plot. New loader.add_manual_curve(start, end) auto-refines via detector on the sub-slice; falls back to BAKE_ACTIVE_C trim. New loader.remove_manual_curve. set_curve_boundaries dispatches by curve type (user-added → _added_curves; detector → existing _boundary_overrides keyed by detector position). User-added curves render with distinct colour.
